ocl:
context Ward
inv: (self.floor mod 2 = 0) and (self.rooms->forAll(v | v.roomNo <> ''))

context Appointment
inv: (self.patient.isInsured) and (self.dateTime <> '' and self.dateTime.size() > 0)

context Admission
inv: (self.patient.isInsured) and (self.admitDate <> '' and self.admitDate.size() > 0)

context InsurancePolicy
inv: ((self.patient.isInsured) and (self.validUntil.size() = 25)) and (self.patient <> null)

context Invoice
inv: self.totalAmount >= 5 and self.totalAmount <= 78

context Invoice
inv: self.totalAmount >= 39 and self.totalAmount <= 78

context Payment
inv: self.amount >= 9 and self.amount <= 17

context Hospital
inv: self.departments->any(x | x.name <> '') <> null

context Department
inv: self.doctors->any(x | x.doctorId <> '') <> null

context Room
inv: ((self.type <> '') and (self.beds->forAll(v | v.isOccupied = true))) and (not((self.type <> '') and (self.beds->forAll(v | v.isOccupied = true))))

context Ward
inv: ((self.floor > 0) and (self.rooms->forAll(v | v.roomNo <> ''))) and (self.floor < -5)

context Ward
inv: (self.rooms->collect(x | x.beds)->size() >= 1) and (not(self.rooms->collect(x | x.beds)->size() >= 1))

context Prescription
inv: ((self.issuedAt <> '') and (self.medications->forAll(v | v.name <> ''))) and (not((self.issuedAt <> '') and (self.medications->forAll(v | v.name <> ''))))

context Diagnosis
inv: (self.record.patient.isInsured <> true) and (not(self.record.patient.isInsured <> true))

context Person
inv: (self.fullName <> null) and (not(self.fullName <> null))

context Bed
inv: ((self.room <> null) and (self.isOccupied = false)) and (not((self.room <> null) and (self.isOccupied = false)))

context MedicalRecord
inv: (self.prescriptions->collect(x | x.medications)->flatten()->notEmpty()) and (not(self.prescriptions->collect(x | x.medications)->flatten()->notEmpty()))

context Procedure
inv: ((self.doctor <> null) and (self.record.patient.isInsured = false)) and (not((self.doctor <> null) and (self.record.patient.isInsured = false)))
